boundaryWarning: Official wording is <24 kW and >25 kW. Do not infer a tariff for exact boundary cases in the uncovered 24-25 kW interval unless the EVSE can be classified by another official source.
roamingRule: Other networks keep the tariff set by their owner; never apply AlterBase energy prices to roaming EVSE.
rule: Apply only to PAN rows positively identified as SEOLIS/AlterBase and only after classifying AC/DC and the official power band from the exact EVSE. Preserve subscriber versus occasional profiles and the occasional session fee. Ambiguous, roaming, or boundary rows remain fail-closed.
